title: Coercion of the Vulnerable
thesis: Cumulatively, more than 76,000 Canadians have died under MAID since 2016. Coercion need not involve force: a state that offers death to the disabled but withholds housing, that offers death to veterans but delays treatment, that offers death to the chronically ill but underfunds palliative care — that pattern is on the public record.

scenes.headline: Coercion of the Vulnerable
scenes.subhead: Seventy-six thousand deaths. The pattern is not random.

scenes.context: Health Canada Annual Reports on MAID, 2016 through 2024. Year-over-year growth has been double-digit since the program began. The 2024 report alone records 16,499 provisions.

scenes.speaker: Office of the Chief Coroner of Ontario, MAiD Death Review Committee
scenes.speaker_meta: Lessons learned — coercion and undue influence cases (2024)
scenes.quote: The Committee has reviewed cases in which the social context of the MAiD request — including pressure from family, financial inability to access alternative care, or the absence of any meaningful alternative — raised concerns about the voluntariness of the request as defined by the legislation.

scenes.speaker: Roger Foley
scenes.quote: When the only door the state opens is the one that ends my life, that is not a choice. That is coercion administered by policy.

scenes.unit: Track 2 share of all 2024 MAID deaths
scenes.context: Track 2 — the cohort whose death is not reasonably foreseeable — has grown every year since C-7. Federal Health Canada reports show the share rising; no composite multi-cause attrition graphic is used here.

scenes.headline: Why this closes the five-act record
scenes.body:
The five acts walk Article 6 elements against primary sources: group and killing (Act II), serious harm (Act III), conditions of life (Act IV), and cumulative volume plus voluntariness concerns (this act). Intent language is in Hansard and the Statutes; volume is in Health Canada annual reports.

Ontario coroner case files and Roger Foley’s Article 15 communication address coercion and lack of alternatives. Film is atmosphere only. Verify every figure on the linked government pages.

scenes.headline: What now
scenes.subhead: Read the evidence. File a Section 504 information. Write your MP. Forward this site.
